authoritative_final_target: Published/supplied-checkpoint AdarEdit canonical-test benchmark at upstream 5c8b57d70cdc2eb1c5e168431013275bcc9ed0c5

architecture.fusion: 32-dimensional projections of global graph, focal-node and aligned-local views; concatenate the three projections and all three elementwise pair interactions; 64-unit fusion MLP; one final logit
architecture.global_encoder: unchanged three-layer compact GAT, hidden_dim=32, heads=4
architecture.global_preservation: training-only binary auxiliary head from the global graph embedding; not used at inference
architecture.local_encoder: unchanged target/helix-partner-aligned +/-32 nt two-layer dilated CNN
architecture.name: unified_target_local_interaction_aux_v1
architecture.target_view: final GAT embedding of the uniquely marked focal nucleotide

primary_candidate.supervision: binary high/low labels from every eligible training-pair observation; equal classes; uniform pair then site sampling; canonical-training-row-sized epoch budget

excluded: continuous/ordinal auxiliary labels: negligible F1 and adverse natural-prevalence result
cross-tissue multi-label sharing: credible but below both frozen promotion gates and worse mean Brier
substrate engagement/context: current direct model failed F1 and recall; no sufficiently strong independent state measurement
RBP, bulk chromatin, foundation-model and generic capacity additions: failed controls or promotion gates
retained: pair-first expanded high/low supervision: replicated with positive clustered intervals in all five endpoints
whole-duplex compact graph representation: authoritative intrinsic backbone
explicit focal-node representation: replicated complementary ranking signal
target/helix-partner-aligned local representation: replicated gain and decisive shifted-window control
representation-level nonlinear interactions plus global auxiliary supervision: direct end-to-end test of whether the ensemble's complementary views can be internalized

controls_if_primary_advances: identical architecture with the focal node replaced by the first-node anchor
identical architecture with the local window shifted 96 nt from the target
staged_decision_rule.final_promotion: The unified family may replace the frozen ensemble only on development evidence: it must show reproducible incremental value over that ensemble, not merely over AdarEdit or one component. Prefer a paired pair-bootstrap lower bound above zero for F1 with nonnegative AUROC/AUPRC, or lower bounds above zero for both AUROC and AUPRC with nonnegative F1, acceptable calibration, and a favorable false-positive/true-positive tradeoff. Replication in Liver is required after Muscle discovery. One global family must then be confirmed across all five endpoints before final freezing.
staged_decision_rule.primary_screen: Complete five-fold pair-disjoint Muscle OOF for the preregistered primary candidate and compare on exactly the frozen ensemble rows and folds.
staged_decision_rule.repair_rule: If the primary candidate fails only through optimization/calibration conflict while retaining complementary ranking, the sole prespecified repair is the no-auxiliary variant. If the primary and repair both fail to add credible value over the ensemble, terminate unified architecture development without architecture search.
staged_decision_rule.test_rule: No canonical-test access, final manifest, or authorization until this development campaign and the final ensemble-versus-unified decision are frozen.
